officialPrimarySources.name: Mesa Parcels ArcGIS Feature Layer (0)
officialPrimarySources.observation: Layer metadata: esriGeometryPolygon, EPSG:2868, maxRecordCount 1000, supports JSON/GeoJSON queries and allowOthersToQuery=true; fields include OBJECTID and APN. Geometry sample remains unverified.

officialPrimarySources.name: City GIS ArcGIS Online Parcels Feature Layer
officialPrimarySources.operator: Mesa City GIS organization (ArcGIS Online owner ITDGIS)
officialPrimarySources.observation: Direct anonymous metadata and bounded full-feature query succeeded. 201,714 service records; Polygon geometry, EPSG:2868; safe identifier fields OBJECTID and APN. This is an alternate publisher because direct requests to maps.mesaaz.gov reset before an HTTP response.

registryAssessment: City Data Hub describes current Mesa parcel polygons reconciled monthly with Maricopa County assessor parcel numbers. The alternate publicly queryable service is published by the Mesa City GIS ArcGIS organization; geometry and safe identifiers were verified directly.

pointCoverage.appReferenceBasis: Explicit nearby city parcel-covered reference; WUP locator remains unchanged.

scope: 23 valid, distinct City of Mesa-hosted parcel polygons verified in thirteen bounded cells around [33.3793,-111.8075], approximately 1.1 km north of the unchanged ranked WUP locator. The WUP point returned an explicit empty collection. Complete object-ID manifests, forced three-row paging, all 23 fresh APN geometry reads, explicit absence, footprint and binding passed. Independent GEOS audit in EPSG:32612 found no invalid geometries, duplicates, sampled overlaps above 0.01 m² or operation errors. The app starts at the tested nearby parcel-covered reference; citywide completeness, legal title, survey accuracy and APN uniqueness outside this sample are unverified.
